settings.title: Settings

settings.thresholdsNote: Thresholds are bounded by the firmware safety envelope. The device rejects the whole config object if a single field is outside its range, so a bad save can never half-apply.
settings.membersHint: Members and roles come from the organization record. Invitations and role changes are not available here.

settings.healthSource: Counts come from the database on this request. Uptime and latency are not measured here.
settings.errorInvalid: Check the values and try again. Thresholds must stay inside the safety envelope.
settings.phonesHint: One per line, international format. The device sends the SMS.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.body: LifeLink stores vehicle location and crash telemetry to deliver emergency alerts. Location data is available only to members of your organization and is retained for the period configured in Settings.
privacy.extra: Telemetry is retained for the period configured in Settings. Incident evidence is retained separately because it may be needed for insurance or legal review. Members of other organizations cannot query your vehicles or incidents.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body: LifeLink is a prototype emergency-response aid. It does not replace emergency services, a functioning vehicle, or a qualified driver. Always call local emergency services first.
terms.extra: The platform is provided as-is for a capstone prototype. A missed alert can have consequences beyond the software's control: cellular coverage, GPS visibility, device power, and sensor mounting all matter. Test the installation on the bench and in the vehicle before relying on it.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Delivery targets, the alert log and emergency contacts.
notifications.policySubtitle: What the intake route does today, read from the incident route and alert templates.
notifications.policyTriggerBody: A device incident report queues alert rows. A suspected incident that is later confirmed queues them if none exist. Incidents the driver cancelled queue none.
notifications.policyTargetsBody: One SMS row per configured phone and one email row per configured email. Targets come from Settings. The HTTP channel exists in the data model but nothing creates HTTP rows.
notifications.policyMessageBody: The prepared SMS body carries the plate, coordinates or location unavailable, GPS age, speed and Philippine time, capped at 320 characters. No email template exists.
notifications.policyDeliveryBody: Rows are created as Queued. No sender or retry worker is implemented in this codebase, so runtime rows stay Queued until another process updates them.
notifications.policySeverityBody: Severity does not choose targets, channels or escalation. It is a display aid.
notifications.policyEscalationBody: No escalation chain, retry policy or responder dispatch is implemented.
notifications.targetsSubtitle: Phones and emails used when an incident report arrives.
notifications.targetsEmptyBody: Phones and emails configured in Settings appear here.
notifications.targetsNormalizeNote: Numbers must contain 10 to 15 digits after other characters are removed; emails must contain @. Entries that fail are skipped before rows are queued.
notifications.targetsManagedByAdmin: An admin manages alert targets in Settings.
notifications.logSubtitle: Every alert row on record for this organisation.
notifications.logEmptyBody: Rows appear when a device reports an incident and alert targets are configured.
notifications.logEmptyFiltered: No alert rows match these filters
notifications.logEmptyFilteredBody: Clear the status or channel filter to see every row.
notifications.contactsSubtitle: People on file for this organisation. Contacts are read-only here.
notifications.contactsEmptyBody: Contacts added for this organisation appear here.
notifications.errorBody: The alert log and contacts did not arrive. Try again, and if it keeps failing, check the health endpoint.
